$comment: Paired A/B for enable_heat_discrete_tier_dispatch: spend each heat tier allocated MW at the CORNERS (serve a chosen subset in full, shed the rest) instead of running every load in the tier at one uniform fraction.

EVIDENCE: on eval_full_v2_20260728-202054 cold_day_stress (90 tasks/variant) the share of heat loads at a corner (0 or 100%) is oracle 84.1%, component_level 82.8%, single_level 82.8% -- all 0/90 t_k violations -- against SCARE 54.5% with 46/90. The oracle sheds MORE loads outright (19.1% vs 16.5%) yet serves MORE heat (+0.115 paired), and at the 86 junctions where SCARE violates it serves the load at a MEDIAN of 100%.

MECHANISM: a DHS junction is held above its t_k floor by mass flow THROUGH it. Uniform per-tier modulation thins flow network-wide and drags every junction toward the floor; serving a chosen subset in full keeps full flow, and therefore temperature, on every path still served. Heat is the one sector where proportional fair-sharing is physically self-defeating. The uniform fraction is applied at L2DispatchHandler._dispatch_service_fractions (holon_component: the negotiator applies the fraction to every community member).

The change redistributes each tier MW without altering the total, so the tier ladder and PWSF accounting are unchanged; one boundary load per tier absorbs the remainder, which is also why the oracle own shape is 84% corners not 100%.

ARMS: {} is CONTROL (uniform fraction, the shipped default -- left as default so this is inert for concurrently running campaigns); enable_heat_discrete_tier_dispatch=true is TREATMENT. Seeds depend only on (experiment, grid, run_idx) so arms are paired on the same failure draw.

SUPERSEDES ab_heat_sensitivity_seed, whose hypothesis (frontier-controller gain) was REFUTED: seed 3500 cut frontier-move saturation 99.3%->69.4% and reversals 0.815->0.624 per load but moved compliance 13/24 -> 11/24 fails, McNemar p=0.754.

JUDGE ON, paired by (grid, scenario, seed): claims__constraint_compliance__passed and by_variable__temperature__n_violations; the CORNER SHARE of per-load heat served fractions (the mechanism check -- must move toward ~84%); heat served fraction and PWSF (must not fall: the oracle gets compliance AND more heat, so a compliance win bought by shedding is a failure).
name: ab_heat_corner_dispatch
